BRIEF: Because of changes in the national policy, the lunar exploratory program is once again functioning, and you have been chosen as the pilot. Your mission is to land on Mare Fremont, a barren and harsh wasteland, believed incapable of supporting any known form of life. The agency chose the best of the last of the human-driven cars. Its onboard computer is a PDP eleven, and it has just died on you. You must now land under manual control. Good luck.
